security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Machine-wide protection with a recovery layer
bundle.longDescription: Cairn protects the sites you have chosen not to visit, across the whole machine. It records that you reached, and nothing else. Everything here is free, local, and reversible.
